visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with wavy medium-length black hair and an orange-brown button-up shirt over a black t-shirt stands excitedly in a brightly lit modern kitchen. He holds a skewer of three yellow sweet potato balls and a clear glass filled with a pinkish drink and ice. Behind him are teal-colored kitchen cabinets and a white wall with a decorative shelf. Red and white text overlays appear at chest level. (2) Close-up view of a hand using a sharp metal knife to slice into a golden-brown, crispy sweet potato ball resting on an orange cutting board. The man's hands are visible as he carefully manipulates the food. The lighting is bright and direct, highlighting the texture of the fried dough. (3) A pair of black chopsticks inserts a small, peeled red tomato into the hollowed-out center of the sliced sweet potato ball. The scene focuses on the colorful contrast between the red tomato and yellow ball on the orange board. White variety-style text appears to the right. (4) The camera shows a completed skewer of three stuffed balls being held upright. A hand enters from the side and sprinkles a fine white powder over the snacks. In the background, three more stuffed balls are arranged on a black plate next to the orange cutting board. (5) The man takes a large bite out of one of the stuffed balls on the skewer, his eyes widening in a show of intense flavor. He stands in the same kitchen setting, looking directly at the camera. A pink jar with a cartoon character is now visible on the counter in the foreground. (6) Close-up of the pink product jar labeled with Chinese text and a Snoopy-like illustration. Next to it is a small white plate of peeled tomatoes. The camera pans to show the black plate of prepared snacks and the iced drink. A small circular inset of the man's face appears as he speaks. (7) Chopsticks reach into the clear liquid inside the jar to lift out a glossy, peeled tomato, with a drop of syrup falling from it. The focus is sharp on the fruit's texture. (8) Hands use a black pestle to vigorously mash tomatoes and plums inside a tall stainless steel cocktail shaker. The man's orange sleeve is visible at the edge of the frame. (9) The mashed red mixture is poured from the metal shaker into a glass filled with large clear ice cubes. More ice and then a clear sparkling liquid are added, causing the mixture to fizz and bubble. (10) A hand carefully places a small green mint leaf and a tomato on a toothpick atop the glass as garnish. The man is then shown drinking the beverage and eating the garnish, displaying a thumbs-up gesture and an expression of extreme satisfaction while gesturing towards the product jar.
